mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% indicates labor market weakness that signals reduced corporate earnings growth potential, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signal robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial expansion (INDPRO growth rate above 2% annually) indicates robust supply chain capacity and corporate production, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth rate exceeds 2%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Annualized CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals heightened risk of monetary tightening and reduced real equity returns, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized rate > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly payroll growth exceeding 135,000 jobs signals a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 135,000, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and rise in unemployment rate signals monetary policy response to labor market weakness, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as stimulus expectations rise.
regime_hint: monetary policy response to labor weakness
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (quarterly annualized rate above 2%) indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.
